purpose: Validation-only staged MLP study; original baselines remain unchanged

stages.name: convergence
stages.question: Does best validation through 60 improve over through 30 or retrospective patience 5?

stages.name: loss
stages.question: Do weighting trade-offs explain failures? Compare against convergence controls.

stages.name: normalization
stages.question: Does within-example normalization reduce the federation gap?

stages.name: heavy_dropout
stages.question: How much does the original heavy/light dropout difference matter?

substitution_only.rule: May replace two later screens after inspecting convergence; never add beyond the 12-run cap. Record decision before launching.

promotion.note: Project preferences, not significance tests or operational standards. All deltas are proportions.

confirmation.rule: Freeze one recipe first; match heavy/light normalization and dropout for a capacity claim. Individual seed-0 effects remain exploratory.

test_policy: No test access during tuning. Existing test already inspected; later evaluation descriptive, not fresh confirmation.
run_policy: Generate commands only; manually authorize each stage. No cloud launch, background scheduler or automatic sweep.
